description:
Add streaming to the Anthropic Messages API client. The v0.1 client
(src/provider/anthropic.rs, landed in bl-9600) is blocking and
non-streaming — fine for a "one model call, one commit" demo, but
non-streaming isn't useful in practice: the UI (ARCH §7, v0.5) needs
token-by-token output, users want incremental feedback on long
responses, and time-to-first-token is a real product metric.

=== What to build ===
- A streaming variant of Client::send (either Client::send_streaming
  returning an iterator/stream of events, or a separate StreamingClient
  type — pick one and justify).
- SSE parsing for Anthropic's event types: message_start, content_block_start,
  content_block_delta, content_block_stop, message_delta, message_stop,
  ping, error. See https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/messages-streaming.
- A typed Event enum covering those variants; unknown events should not
  break the stream.
- An accumulator helper that folds a stream of events back into the
  existing Response type, so callers that don't care about incremental
  delivery can still get the final object.
- Error taxonomy reuses src/provider/anthropic::Error; add any new
  variants needed (e.g. malformed SSE frame).

=== Design questions to resolve when claimed ===
- Blocking vs async. The v0.1 client picked blocking because there was
  no concurrency. Streaming typically wants async, but reqwest::blocking
  supports chunked reads — decide whether to stay blocking for v0.1/v0.2
  cohesion or switch to tokio now.
- On-disk cadence: does streaming write partial step commits, or still
  one commit per terminal event? This interacts with ARCH §2.3 (steps
  are linear commits). Default: one commit at stream-end, but document
  the decision.
- anthropic-version: the base client hard-codes "2023-06-01"; verify
  the streaming event schema is covered under that version.

=== Out of scope ===
- Prompt caching.
- Tool-use streaming events (blocks of type tool_use) — fold in when
  v0.3 adds tool use.
- UI consumption of the stream (that's v0.5 work).

=== Testing ===
- Mock SSE responses against httpmock (or a small hand-rolled server if
  httpmock's SSE support is awkward). Cover: well-formed stream with
  text deltas, a stream with an error event mid-flight, a truncated
  stream (connection closed early), unknown event types, the accumulator
  round-tripping to a Response that matches the non-streaming parser.
- cargo test + tarpaulin --fail-under 100 green. No live API calls.

=== Why not fold into v0.1 ===
ARCH §12 v0.1 scope is "single prompt, single response, single commit"
with streaming explicitly deferred. Doing streaming now would expand
v0.1 past its success criterion. Filed as backlog; natural pull point
is either right after v0.1 ships (so v0.2 exchanges stream) or as part
of v0.5 UI.
title: Anthropic client: streaming SSE support
